description: Defines the ObservationBuffer class for storing and processing network quality observations, including methods for adding observations, computing percentiles, and managing observation data. It is part of the network quality estimation subsystem in Chromium.

classes.name: ObservationBuffer
classes.description: A class that stores network quality observations, provides utility functions for statistical analysis, and manages observation data with features like percentile calculation and observation removal.

methods.name: AddObservation
methods.description: Adds a new network quality observation to the buffer, evicting the oldest if full.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current number of observations stored.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all observations from the buffer.

methods.name: GetPercentile
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves a specified percentile of observations made after a given timestamp, considering current signal strength.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom tick clock for testing purposes.

methods.name: ComputeWeightedObservations
methods.description: Calculates weighted observations based on age and signal strength.
